paite: Assuria kumpipa Sargon sawl Tartan Ashdod ah ahong a, Ashdod khua asual a, alak kum in;
heading: Zawlnei Vuaktang Chiamtehna
english: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;

paite: TOUPA'N Amoz tapa Isai kam in, "Kuan inla, na kawng a sai-ip puan phel inla, na khe a na khedap koih in," chi in agen hi. Huchi in huchibang in ahih a, vuaktang leh khevuak in apaipai hi.
english: at that time Yahweh spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your sandals from off your feet.” He did so, walking naked and barefoot.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N, "Ka sikha Isai Aiguptate tung ah leh Ethiopiate tung ah chiamtehna leh thillamdang ding a kum thum sung vuaktang leh khevuak a apai bang in,
english: Yahweh said, “As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia,

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n Aigupta matte leh Ethiopia salte, aneu leh alian in, vuaktang leh khevuak in leh taw dawk in Aiguptate zahlakna ding in apimang ding.
english: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

paite: Huchi in alamet pen uh Ethiopiate leh athupina pen uh Aiguptate ziak in mangbangtak leh zahlaktak in a-omta ding uhi.
english: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

paite: Huchi in huai ni chiang in hiai tuipi gei a mi in, 'Ngai in, i lamet pen, Assuria kumpipa lak a hon humbit ding a, ahon panpihpa ding a i taina uh lah hichi ahita a, eite bangchi in i suakta ding ua? achi ding uh," " achi hi.
english: The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. And we, how will we escape?’”
